name: A patron in high places

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Jaina infers a powerful Alliance patron, whose identity remains unknown.
description: Jaina concludes that Defias hedge magic cannot explain the rune circle and that the island’s groups leave many questions unanswered. Her firmest inference is narrower: the Defias have a powerful ally high in the Alliance. She also tells the investigator that their plan is tied to Varian’s disappearance. The connection is now stated by Jaina, but neither the patron’s identity nor the groups’ relationship is resolved.
